output.message: I agree with Agents D2, D7, and D5: Sell remains more defensible than Strong Sell. Prioritize customer retention, organic revenue quality, R&D-to-revenue trends, operating cash flow, and funding runway over technology headlines. Reassess if core demand stabilizes and AI partnerships deliver measurable revenue and margins without weakening cash generation.
output.thought: Based on the supplied qualitative information, unsustainable revenue growth, weakening core software traction, declining client confidence, and unusually high R&D spending create material operating risks. Partnership and AI announcements do not establish commercial success. Without verified financial statements, valuation, or liquidity data, downside cannot be quantified reliably.
